questions.question: The theorem requires finite-dimensional associative real division algebras: A. W. Knapp, Advanced Algebra, Theorem 2.50, p. 118, https://www.math.stonybrook.edu/~aknapp/download/a2-alg-inside.pdf . Approve those conditions in both versions and rewrite the unrestricted exclusion of dimensions five and higher, which conflicts with the eight-dimensional octonions mentioned in the same note. The author’s statements remain pending that decision.

localizations.ru: Для теоремы нужны конечномерные ассоциативные действительные алгебры с делением: A. W. Knapp, Advanced Algebra, теорема 2.50, с. 118, https://www.math.stonybrook.edu/~aknapp/download/a2-alg-inside.pdf . Согласовать эти условия в обеих версиях и переписать безусловное «не бывает пяти- или более-мерных»: оно противоречит упомянутым здесь же октавам размерности 8. До решения авторские формулировки сохранены.

questions.resolution: The theorem’s hypotheses and dimension statement now follow A. W. Knapp, Advanced Algebra, Theorem 2.50, p. 118; octonions are explicitly separated as a nonassociative case. https://www.math.stonybrook.edu/~aknapp/download/a2-alg-inside.pdf

questions.question: Clarify the conditions ensuring a largest nonrepresentable amount in the general coin problem, particularly coprime denominations. The example with denominations 3 and 5 and answer 7 is unchanged.

questions.resolution: The general statement now specifies positive integer denominations with gcd 1, which ensures that a largest nonrepresentable amount exists.
